description: This file contains the implementation of the VoucherTheme class, which manages voucher theme entities in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving voucher themes and their descriptions from the database.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: Represents voucher theme entities with methods to manage CRUD operations and descriptions.

methods.name: addVoucherTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new voucher theme record into the database and adds associated descriptions.

methods.name: editVoucherTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing voucher theme, including its image and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteVoucherTheme
methods.description: Deletes a voucher theme and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getVoucherTheme
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific voucher theme, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getVoucherThemes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all voucher themes, with optional ordering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalVoucherThemes
methods.description: Returns the total count of voucher themes in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific voucher theme in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific voucher theme.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in the database for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific voucher theme.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all voucher theme descriptions for a specific language.
